- Expected sustained throughput: ~200 requests/sec (peak bursts up to ~400req/s for ~5–10s)

Based on that, the right next step is a dedicated capacity sizing call with one of our solutions engineers to align on instance footprint, batching and KV cache strategy, and an initial cost estimate.
